name: The Mongs

tenures.role: DPW Tag Team Champions, won at Intoxicated (4 March 2004) and defended through Under The Influence (23 April 2004).
tenures.source: The federation's own Intoxicated, Beer Muscles, and Under The Influence results.

caption: The Wolfpack3000's own tag team, DPW Tag Team Champions from Intoxicated through the spring of 2004.

name: The Prodigy

tenures.role: Heavyweight Champion Mitch Armour's own stable of allies, expanding through the winter of 2004 until two of its own newest members betrayed it.
tenures.source: The federation's own News & Updates bulletins and card results, January-April 2004.

caption: Heavyweight Champion Mitch Armour's own stable, which grew through the winter of 2004 until two of its newest members betrayed it.

identity.note: Name collision only: a same-named entity in another wing (the-prodigy); no shared operator, chronology or storyline evidence in this wing's documents.

name: The Pack

tenures.role: The federation's own front-office stable, built around its operator and commentators, and rivals of both the Prodigy and the Wolfpack3000.
tenures.source: The federation's own News & Updates bulletin of 4 March 2004 and later card results.

caption: The federation's own front-office stable, built around its operator and commentators.

name: Wolfpack3000

tenures.role: A rowdy faction that won the DPW Tag Team Championship and fought both the Prodigy and the Pack through the spring of 2004.
tenures.source: The federation's own Bar Fight, Intoxicated, and later card results.

caption: A rowdy faction whose own Mongs won the Tag Team Championship, feuding with both the Prodigy and the Pack.

name: Prodigal Son Inc.

tenures.role: Formed when Jason Kelly and Mathias Mathews betrayed the Prodigy and Mathews won the Heavyweight Championship.
tenures.source: The federation's own Sex on the Beach results and its News & Updates bulletin of 26 April 2004.

caption: The breakaway pairing of the new Heavyweight Champion Mathias Mathews and his own turncoat cornerman Jason Kelly.

name: The Enforcers

tenures.role: A military-themed stable formed the night Bill Clinton won the Intercontinental Championship, joined at ringside by a turncoat Slicer.
tenures.source: The federation's own Under The Influence results.

caption: A military-themed stable formed the night its own leader won the Intercontinental Championship.
